g.title: Binary RE / Architecture, load commands, segments — Verified — All 28 load commands and 23 sections tabulated; independently re-derived.

rect.title: Binary RE / String → xref → function workflow — Implemented — String census (4-byte TCHAR) + per-function string/xref export.

rect.title: UE3 Packages / Malformed-input rejection tests — Implemented — Truncation at every offset, byte flips, extreme values, cycles, chunk/block attacks; no panics.

g.title: Compression / Meaning of CompressionFlags = 2 for this build — Verified — CompressionFlags=2 is LZO1X: every block of 38 packages decompresses to the declared size; SHA-identical to liblzo2.
Compression / Package-level compressed chunk table — Verified — 485 chunks / 12,063 blocks of 0x20000; layout invariants hold for all packages.
Compression / Per-chunk block header layout — Verified — 485 chunks / 12,063 blocks of 0x20000; layout invariants hold for all packages.
Compression / Bounds-checked LZO1X decompressor — Verified — Safe LZO1X; identical output to liblzo2 and an independent decoder on all 12,063 real blocks; 70k-case differential fuzz.
Compression / Every compressed package decompresses and re-parses — Verified — 485 chunks / 12,063 blocks of 0x20000; layout invariants hold for all packages.
Compression / Uncompressed package path — Verified — 4 uncompressed packages parse with zero findings.

Assets / Audio (SoundNodeWave) — Verified — 852 waves consumed exactly; Ogg streams valid; independent checker agreed.
Assets / Level transforms and lights — Verified — 30,284 actor LocalToWorld matrices and 3,437 light components re-derived independently.

rect.title: Player / Deterministic fixed-step simulation harness — Implemented — Pure fixed-step step(); byte-identical determinism tests; NaN/dt guards. Movement model itself is a placeholder.
Player / Ground movement / acceleration — Implemented — Native physics port with original values (GroundSpeed 440, AccelRate 2048, friction 8). Not trace-verified.
Player / Air control — Implemented — Native limiter with original AirControl 0.3 -> 0.35 after first landing, bLimitFallAccel true.
Player / Jump — Implemented — JumpZ 1000 + releasable-jump damping x0.7 per ABILITIES.md.
Player / Gravity — Implemented — Native gravity chain + 2x falling integrator ported; DefaultGravityZ=-520 from config. Not trace-verified.
Player / Collision dimensions — Implemented — Cylinder radius 21 / half-height 44 (UTPawn template).
Player / Camera — Implemented — Eye height smoothing, bob, previous-frame view for aims.
Player / FOV — Implemented — FOV 90 (settings), zoom 90->50.
Player / Input bindings (DefaultInput.ini) — Implemented — DefaultInput.ini actions; mouse-look scaling formula not ported (documented deviation).

Grapple / Constraint / swing behaviour — Implemented — Grappling-state physics per GRAPPLE.md. Not trace-verified.
Grapple / Release momentum — Implemented — Release at 200 uu, 0.05 s instant release, button/landing paths. Not trace-verified.
Grapple / Maximum speed — Implemented — 2000 cap on 3-D speed while attached. Not trace-verified.
Grapple / Suit ability progression / unlocks — Implemented — Grapple budget/recharge, power jump/leap, rocket boots, per-level unlock state. Not trace-verified.
World / Level loading from converted data — Implemented — Converted scenes load in 20-67 ms; player spawns grounded on all 10 maps with a PlayerStart.
World / Triggers — Implemented — Trigger/TriggerVolume touch events emitted as sim events (Kismet runtime consumes later).
World / Checkpoints — Implemented — Highest-index save rule, spawn transforms, negative-index fallback per script.
World / Death / reset — Implemented — Kill zones + KillZ death sequence with respawn after 18 ticks at latest checkpoint.
World / Moving platforms (interpolation) — Implemented — Matinee movers + attached actors + player basing; 267/267 positions match direct curve evaluation.
World / Level streaming — Implemented — Freds_place always with BeautifulCity; TheCore streamed on request.
World / Story sequencing — Implemented — Level-start abilities, checkpoints, narrator lines, transitions driven by the original Kismet graphs.

World / Interactables, collectibles and story items in levels — Partial — Interactables, collectibles, story items, glow flowers implemented in NpcSystem; save/UI wiring pending.
